reasonCodeDictionary.HR-QUARANTINED-NO-STABLE-LINES: Lacks stable line or paragraph coordinates; page-level locators only.
reasonCodeDictionary.HR-QUARANTINED-EDUCATIONAL-NOT-STATUTORY: Educational guidance, practice note, or non-binding commentary; excluded from authoritative statutory standard.
reasonCodeDictionary.HR-QUARANTINED-STAGED-PENDING-REVIEW: Staged document extracted in M5 scale pilot; pending human promotion decision and scope clearance.
reasonCodeDictionary.HR-REJECTED-UNADOPTED-EDITION: Draft proposal, prospective amendment, or unadopted edition text; strictly rejected under anti-fabrication regulatory policy.
reasonCodeDictionary.HR-MISSING-LOCAL-SOURCE: Document cataloged on external intake root, but physical file absent from local repository checkout.
